name: SFX design and mix
summary: Seven soft synthesized effects and an ffmpeg mix (voice -16 LUFS, effects, ducked bed) with measured loudness, true peak and envelope plots.
qualityBar: Each effect: length within 10 ms, peak -3.0 dBFS, no click, deterministic, pitch/envelope as designed
Loudness meter reads a -20 dBFS 997 Hz sine as -23.0 LUFS and a 0.5 sine as -6.02 dBTP (+-0.3)
Demo mix -16.0 LUFS and true peak -4.5 dBTP (gates -18..-14 LUFS, <= -1 dBTP); bed 21.9 LU under the voice; effects 6+ dB under the voice
Ducking by A/B: 5.2-6.4 dB under speech, back to 0.0 dB half a second after
Each effect mixed alone lands within 15 ms of its time (whoosh 68 ms: soft rise)
demo_av.mp4 passes the gates after AAC (-16.0 LUFS, -4.6 dBTP), audio within 30 ms of the wav
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at 1080x1920 (81 checks passed, 0 failed; engine QC on card and mp4 passed with 1 warning). Effects, meter, mix, ducking (A/B), effect placement and the mp4's loudness measured with ffmpeg and own FFT; viewed out/contact.png, out/sfx_envelopes.png and out/mix_envelopes.png and judged them good. NOT checked: nobody listened (levels, ducking taste, effect character are measured only); effects not A/B compared by ear with the originals (tick's peak now -3.0 dBFS because fades are applied before normalisation); one voice (Heart) and one 16 s bed excerpt; a full 3-minute lesson was not remixed with this module; true peak is ffmpeg's estimate.
